* fix(core): make clearNodes unwrap every level of a nested list

`clearNodes()` walked `state.doc` — the document as it was before its own
transaction — while mutating `tr`. Two problems followed.

A lift can only become legal after an earlier lift in the same transaction:
`listItem` is `paragraph block*`, so an item still holding a nested list
cannot be lifted until that list is out of it. With a single sweep there is
no second chance, so the item stays wrapped and "clear formatting" flattens
every item except the ones with children.

Positions taken from the stale document could also land on a node that
cannot take the default type, so `setNodeMarkup` threw
`RangeError: Invalid content for node type paragraph` — reachable from
`.clearNodes().toggleOrderedList()` in one chain.

Each range is now swept against the transaction's current document until it
stops changing, and the retype is skipped when the target cannot hold its
own content as the default type.

Fixes #8175

* fix(core): address review on clearNodes

- drop the fixed sweep cap; the loop ends when the document stops changing
- changeset now describes user-visible behaviour and uses the dated filename
- add a deeply nested list case

* fix(core): keep clearNodes correct when the chain already changed the doc

The ranges come from the selection in the current document, but they were
mapped through the whole transaction. When another command in the same chain
had already added steps, that mapped them a second time and the sweep ran off
the end of the document.

Map from the start of this command instead. Also rebuild the per-sweep
mapping only when a step actually lands, rather than for every node visited.

* fix(core): stop clearNodes retyping nodes that already match

`setNodeMarkup` does not diff, so a textblock that already carries the
default markup still got a step that changed nothing. Those steps land in
the undo stack and go out to collaborating clients.

Skip the retype when the node already has that markup. Clearing an
already-flat selection now produces no steps at all, and the nested-list
case drops from 13 steps to 4.

Also cover a selection that only spans part of the document.

* test(core): use a real range for the partial-selection clearNodes case

* refactor(core): address review on clearNodes

- bound the sweep loop by the nesting depth of the range
- rename commandStart/sweepStart to say what they hold
- lift the mapped range out of the nodesBetween call
- shorten the comments

* test(core): import ListItem from @tiptap/extension-list

@tiptap/extension-list-item was removed from the repo, which broke this suite at collection time.
